title: elutheria microphylla
intro: Elutheria microphylla, commonly known as "Mexican Coltsfoot", is a plant species native to Mexico. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant is valued for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, helping to soothe and clear the airways. The bioactive constituents of Elutheria microphylla, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, are responsible for its medicinal properties, contributing to its use as a natural remedy for various health conditions.
